standard_prerequisites.name: Chinese remainder: for pairwise distinct maximal ideals the product map M -> the direct sum of the quotients M(x_i) is surjective
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the surjection M -> M(x_1) plus ... plus M(x_n) whose preimages give the required section.

core_obligations: Each x_i is a maximal ideal of R (proof line 38802), and the x_i are pairwise distinct (statement lines 38796-38797), so the Chinese remainder lemma applies to give that M(x_1) plus ... plus M(x_n) is a quotient of M (proof lines 38802-38805). Choosing a preimage s of the tuple (v_1, ..., v_n) gives s in M whose value at each x_i maps to v_i (proof lines 38805-38806).
proof_roadmap: Identify the x_i as pairwise distinct maximal ideals so Chinese remainder applies (proof lines 38802-38804).
Take a preimage s of the prescribed tuple in the quotient M(x_1) plus ... plus M(x_n) (proof lines 38804-38806).
